description:
During your upkeep, activate Mairsil by sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Mairsil dies, triggering Kaya's Ghostform, returning Mairsil from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Mairsil using Hakim's first ability by paying {U}{U}, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Mairsil.
Repeat.
